editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your hand has turned into a living, breathing snake head. That is exactly what happens to the unlucky guy in this wild ride. After a radioactive snake bite, he goes from a normal person to a human snake hybrid. It starts with just the hand, but soon his whole body is filled with reptiles. The vibe is totally over-the-top and feels like a fever dream from the eighties. You get a mix of body horror and goofy situations as he tries to keep his new limb from biting everyone he meets.

What really makes this one a trip are the weird effects and the fast pace. The acting is a bit stiff, but that actually adds to the charm of these old B-movies. If you love stories where things go wrong in the strangest ways possible, you will have a blast. It is not a masterpiece, but it is great for a movie night with friends. You should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick laugh. If you are a big fan of weird horror, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character can no longer control the snakes inside him. As the transformation takes over, he becomes a complete monster. In the final scenes, the chaos peaks as he attacks those around him. He eventually meets a grim end because there is no cure for the radioactive mutation. It wraps up with a bloody mess, showing that once you turn into a snake man, there is no going back to normal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy 80s creature features.
